results.quote: Unless the ETH fails, there is a constant \(\gamma>0\) such that Max Independent Set does not admit a polynomial-time \(n^{\gamma/(loglogn)^2}\)-approximation algorithm on n-vertex graphs of twin-width at most 4, even when a 4-sequence is given as part of the input.

Unless the ETH fails, there is a constant \(\gamma>0\) such that Min Coloring does not admit a polynomial-time \(n^{\gamma/(loglogn)^2}\)-approximation algorithm on n-vertex graphs of twin-width at most 4, even when a 4-sequence is given as part of the input.
\(\forall r=o(k)\), k-Independent Set is W[1]-hard in graphs of bounded mw<sub>r</sub>.
\(\forall r=o(k)\), k-Dominating Set is W[1]-hard in graphs of bounded mw<sub>r</sub>.
